decisions.0: Nine-eight suited plays well in position-poor spots because it makes straights and flushes. It is a pure defend against a button open.
decisions.1: With a flush draw and a backdoor straight draw you have plenty of equity against a small c-bet. Raising and calling are almost tied; raising wins the pot right away more often.
decisions.3: The deuce bricked your draws, and a two-thirds pot bet gets a lot of value from the button. Calling is barely profitable; folding is close.

takeaway: Big draws can raise small c-bets; when the turn bricks, the price matters more than the draw.
